summary: A mixed legal and retail day, anchored by Reliance's massive Rs 10 lakh crore AI investment commitment and a $1.3 billion bond sale, alongside competitive moves from PepsiCo and Titan in India's consumer markets.

bullets.text: Reliance and Jio to invest Rs 10 lakh crore over seven years for India's AI transformation, Mukesh Ambani announced.
Reliance plans $1.3 billion bond sale, India's biggest this year, signaling major capital raise.
PepsiCo plans Rs 5,700 crore investment by 2030 to make India one of its top ten global markets.
Titan's Skinn and Fastrack fragrance brands target 8 million units and Rs 1,000 crore turnover by FY30.
Maharashtra anti-conversion law challenged before Bombay High Court in constitutional petition.
